args.subject: PHL label confusion: Pellow Home Living / Covey & Lark
args.body:
June,

A quick note on a label mix-up for Pellow Home Living (PHL):

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark on 16 February.
- Moss's coverage digest says a saved report still reads 'Covey — Late Arrivals'.
- The saved report's label likely needs updating to the new name so PHL reporting stays consistent.

Raised by Sofia Marchetti (Coastal team). Let us know if you want the report label changed or want us to check other saved reports.

Thanks
